description: Oregon Coastal Atlas is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by Oregon Coastal Management Program; Oregon State University | College of Earth, Ocean, and Atmospheric Sciences | Geosciences; Ecotrust. This website offers a collection of digital tools and background information to inform decision making for the Oregon Coastal Zone. The site provides background information for different coastal systems, access to interactive mapping, online geospatial analysis tools, and direct download of various planning and natural resource datasets. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Flooding – Coastal, Landslides, Water Quality. Assets: Aquatic and Marine Resources, Natural Areas and Wildlife, Property, Water Infrastructure – Stormwater. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
